name: 手记楷体
description: Kaiti/STKaiti 楷体 + 米白底 #FDF9F2 + 暖棕 #8B5A2B，纯楷体手记风格（现有库无纯楷体主题）。借鉴 github.com/GordenSun/WX 方法：H1 居中短粗底线、H2 虚线底、H3 左竖条、blockquote 居中italic、hr 细短线。适合随笔/读后感/日记/生活专栏。

styles.h1: font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; color: #2A2520; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 26px; padding-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: 3px; font-family: 'KaiTi','STKaiti','楷体',serif;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #2A2520; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #8B5A2B; letter-spacing: 2px; font-family: 'KaiTi','STKaiti','楷体',serif;
styles.h3: font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: #8B5A2B; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 3px solid #8B5A2B; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h4: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #5C4E3A; line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #5C4E3A; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.h6: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #8A7659; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.p: font-size: 17px; color: #2A2520; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: font-size: 16px; color: #5C4E3A; line-height: 1.95; text-align: center; font-style: italic; border-top: 1px solid #8B5A2B; border-bottom: 1px solid #8B5A2B; background: transparent; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 16px; color: #5C4E3A; line-height: 1.95; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 1px; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; display: block; border: 1px solid #E8DDC8; background: transparent; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 2px; width: 60px; background: #8B5A2B; border: none;
styles.code: background: transparent; border: 1px solid #8B5A2B; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 92%; color: #8B5A2B; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FAF5E6; border: 1px solid #E8DDC8; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #2A2520; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #F4EDE0; color: #5C4E3A; font-size: 12px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #2A2520; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 15px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #8B5A2B; background: #F4EDE0; border-bottom: 1px solid #8B5A2B;
styles.li: font-size: 17px; color: #2A2520; line-height: 2; letter-spacing: 0.6px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #8A7659; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
